scope: cold archive page cache plus observed process storage reads; durable regular-file extraction; not hardware-cache-cold or public CLI qualification
rss_scope: max_extraction_peak_rss is process-lifetime peak observed before verification, including startup; whole-process max additionally includes post-timing verification

statistics.pairing: same measured round; warmups excluded; ratios candidate/baseline
statistics.confidence_interval: 95% paired percentile bootstrap on mean log ratios, no multiplicity adjustment
statistics.median_definition: mean of central two order statistics for even sample counts

complete_record.cold_gate: sync -d, fadvise DONTNEED, fincore RES == 0; sample must report process storage_io.read_bytes >= 90% of logical payload
